name: Midnight Wanderer
source:
A traveling human stumbles upon a creature camping out in the woods. That human would happen to be you, and, lucky for you, the creature in question is quite friendly.

Listen to their tale of 900 words: the great escape from the jaws of a giant whale.

[from [url=https://inkycat186.itch.io/midnight-wanderer]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一个旅行的人类偶然发现了一个在树林里露营的生物。那个人类恰好就是你，而且幸运的是，这个生物非常友好。

听听他们900字的故事：从巨鲸的嘴里逃脱。

[来自[url=https://inkycat186.itch.io/midnight-wanderer]itch.io[/url]]
